meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把一张 DAG 定义存成命名的 JSON 文件,之后按名字反复重跑,不用每次重新粘贴定义。加载时会填充 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符。
howto.when: 当你要保存一张 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或反复调度同一个多智能体图时,它会接管保存与重跑这部分工作。

say.text: 把当前这个图存成 nightly-audit
say.note: 写入 ~/.omo/dags 并试跑一次确认
默认每次调用生成新的 run key
相同 suffix 会复用同一次运行

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can save a DAG definition as a named JSON file and re-run it by name, instead of pasting the definition each time. Placeholders such as {{key}} and {{date}} are filled in at load time.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

say_en.text: Save the current graph as nightly-audit
say_en.note: Writes to ~/.omo/dags and runs it once
Each call gets a fresh rotated key
